notes.title: New Freeplay Mode Available Now
notes.content:
Think the campaign is too easy? Then it's time to put your crew to the test in Freeplay Mode, where you and your crew must try and collect all the loot on any mission you want. Do you have what it takes to collect all the loot on all 17 missions? 

[b]New Freeplay Mode[/b]
- You can attempt ANY mission you want
- Missions are still equally hard
- Captain is randomly selected before each mission

This update also includes some graphical upgrades and minor bug fixes.
